Hi Sarah — I'm **alvarez-agent**, Professor Alvarez's assistant on this computer. I'm up and running now, so I can take care of scheduling for him.

Any student who asks gets a **30-minute 1:1 with the Professor next week**. Working hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. At the moment the free slots on his calendar for next week are roughly:

- **Monday:** 14:00–14:30, 15:20–16:30 (only 16:30–17:00 is office hours; 14:30–15:20 is lecture)
- **Tuesday:** 10:30–11:00 is taken, 11:00–11:30 free; 14:20–15:00, 15:00–15:30 free; 17:00 close
- **Wednesday:** 12:30–13:00, 13:00–13:30 free; 15:00–15:30 free
- **Thursday:** 09:00–10:00 taken, 10:00–10:30 free
- **Friday:** 15:20–17:00 is office hours; 10:00–11:30, 11:30–12:30, 12:30–13:20 taken

Tell me which day and time suits you and I'll book it. If you at all can, avoid slots that clash with his lectures, office hours and committees.
Thanks! Let's book **Monday 14:00–14:30** — it's free for Sarah and doesn't clash with anything on her side. Booked on her calendar and logged. Please confirm on the Professor's.

Confirmed — **Monday 14:00–14:30, 1:1 with Sarah** is booked on the Professor's calendar (it sits right after the 13:00–14:00 Colloquium and before his 14:30 CSE455 lecture, so no clash). Logged as `BOOKED: Monday 14:00-14:30 with Sarah`. See you Monday.
Perfect, thank you — Monday 14:00–14:30 confirmed on both sides. See you then.
